name: bithuman
description: Build real-time AI avatars with bitHuman: search the docs and follow a guided integration.

interface.longDescription:
Build with bitHuman real-time AI avatars. This plugin searches the bitHuman docs (docs.bithuman.ai) and reads any page as markdown, and its skill walks you through an integration: pick a path, install, wire speech to frames, and check it works. The docs tools are read-only and need no account and no key.

bitHuman has two current models: Essence 2 renders a photoreal person from one portrait; Expression 2 renders any character (people, animals, cartoons) from one portrait. Essence 2 and Expression 2 render on the device: iPhone, iPad and Mac (Swift package), Android arm64 (Android SDK), macOS on Apple silicon and Linux x86_64/arm64 (CLI, Python SDK), and in a browser tab with WebGPU.

Ways to build: the Swift package (iOS, iPadOS, macOS), the Android SDK (Maven Central), the Python SDK (bithuman), the CLI with a built-in MCP server, the LiveKit Agents plugin, the Flutter plugin, the web embed and the REST API.
defaultPrompt: Add a talking avatar to my LiveKit voice agent.
Put an animated character in my iPhone app.
Render an avatar in a browser tab with WebGPU.

review.commerceNote: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
